expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "for an AI-heavy codebase this is probably over-split. I'd merge most of it back."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "Collapse the view, logic, and types into a single UserBadge.tsx."

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell / cross-file context problem
expectations.evidence: "a 'dumb' render file whose props are shaped by a sibling the agent won't open... doubled the cross-file lookups."

expectations.text: Keeps styles separate as the defensible split
expectations.evidence: "Keep styles.ts separate... styles genuinely pass the isolation test."
